text: J.D. Salinger's The Catcher in the Rye was listed in Ireland in 1951 by the Censorship of Publications Board on its register of "Prohibited Publications". In 1960, a teacher in Tulsa, Oklahoma, was fired for assigning the novel in class and was later reinstated. In Columbus, Ohio, in 1963 it was accused of being "anti-white", and in Issaquah, Washington, in 1978 of being part of a "communist plot to gain a foothold in schools".
